value.rationale: The source explicitly supplies an infinite class of stationary examples but leaves the natural question of whether they exhaust all stationary probabilities. Exact all-Borel classification reveals a sharp, parameter-independent switch from an infinite-dimensional invariant-measure simplex to unique Haar stationary probability at drift balance, including its previously untreated reverse-drift range. The quantified uniform linear Wasserstein transition and the sharp lower witness expose persistence of dense atomic full-support stationary measures at maximal total-variation distance. This is structural dynamical information, not merely a renaming or the calculation of one particular atom.
